message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the **long‑weekend holidays** that apply across Canada in 2023 (i.e., federal holidays that fall on a Friday or Monday, or are observed on a Monday when they land on a weekend).  
If you’re targeting a specific province, let me know—some holidays (e.g., Family Day, St. Patrick’s Day, etc.) differ by region—but the list below covers the nationwide “standard” long weekends.

| Holiday | Date in 2023 | Observed (if different) | Weekend Days Included |
|---------|--------------|--------------------------|-----------------------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Jan 1 (Sunday) | Observed Mon Jan 2 | Sun Jan 1 – Mon Jan 2 |
| **Family Day** *(Alberta, BC, ON, SK)* | Feb 20 (Monday) | — | Sat Feb 18 – Mon Feb 20 |
| **Good Friday** | Apr 7 (Friday) | — | Fri Apr 7 – Sun Apr 9 |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 (Monday) | — | Sat May 20 – Mon May 22 |
| **Canada Day** | Jul 1 (Saturday) | Observed Mon Jul 3 | Sat Jul 1 – Mon Jul 3 |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 4 (Monday) | — | Sat Sep 2 – Mon Sep 4 |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 9 (Monday) | — | Sat Oct 7 – Mon Oct 9 |
| **Christmas Day** | Dec 25 (Monday) | — | Sat Dec 23 – Mon Dec 25 |

### Quick Notes

* **Remembrance Day** (Nov 11, Thursday) is observed on the same day; it does *not* create a long weekend.  
* **Boxing Day** (Dec 26, Tuesday) likewise isn’t a long weekend.  
* Provincial holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, St. George’s Day in PEI, etc.) can add extra long weekends in certain regions—just let me know if you’d like those details.

Feel free to copy/paste this table into your holiday‑planning app, or let me know if you’d prefer a JSON array or another format!
